title: compatibility and native conformance inventory
description: machine-checkable inventory of every compatibility path, support route, retained registered route, smart-rule field, sort mapping, filter translation, operator family and advertised profile at the recorded whio revision. it records obligations, not evidence: a registered route is not a conformant capability, so no entry may claim conformant and no entry carries a percentage, a completion date or a done flag. counts mirror array lengths; subsonic 48 and navidrome 30 are the pinned target counts and exclude retained_uncalled, which are registered grammar routes outside the pinned client's called set. validate with tools/check-compat-manifest.sh, which resolves every owner_task against the task ledger when one is supplied or found under <root>/docs, and otherwise against its embedded ledger ID set with an explicit skipped-validation warning. the planning documents this derives from are local-only and are never required for validation.

sources.description: revisions and derived sources. the planning documents are gitignored and are never required for validation.

status_values.description: the closed status enum, repeated so a consumer does not have to read the schema file.

counts.description: every value equals the referenced array length. subsonic 48 and navidrome 30 are the pinned target counts: they count only rows[] entries with in_target true, so the Subsonic-grammar and Navidrome-grammar routes that are registered outside the pinned client's called set live in retained_uncalled (2) and are deliberately not part of the 48/30 targets. the field, sort, filter, operator and profile figures are the other pinned P0 targets and may not drift.

rows.description: Subsonic paths, called Navidrome method/path pairs and support routes: the 48 and 30 targets (in_target true) plus the support mounts, media, share, health and native routes (in_target false).

retained_uncalled.description: registered Subsonic-grammar and Navidrome-grammar routes at this revision that are outside the pinned client's called set (getStarred2, GET /api/genre). they are kept because they are registered, and kept out of the 48/30 target counts and out of rows[] because they are not targets. status is registered, never conformant.

field_mappings.description: all 132 smart-rule field names with their client type, proposed whio fact owner and value. foreign names are verbatim.

sort_mappings.description: all 53 resource/sort values with the proposed whio order fact.

filter_translations.description: all 21 foreign filter inputs and the native selector they must translate to.

operators.description: the five client operator families with accepted foreign operator names and the whio operation family.

profiles.description: advertised profiles. a cumulative Navidrome threshold never skips an earlier obligation; an extension is advertised only from complete behaviour proof.

status.description: unproved: no evidence yet. registered: a router entry exists at the recorded whio revision. conformant: reserved value; F04 must not emit it because route registration is not behaviour.

owner_task.description: task-ledger ID from docs/implementation-tasks.md. the check script resolves it against the task-ID set extracted from a ledger file passed with --tasks (or a plain path argument) or found at <root>/docs/implementation-tasks.md|.json, and against its embedded ledger ID set when no ledger file exists. the docs tree is gitignored, so a checkout without it still validates.

profile.description: wire profile a row is served under: the OpenSubsonic extension set, a cumulative Navidrome compatibility threshold, or a native/compat support surface.

required_response_fields.description: response fields the owning task must guarantee. an empty array is an obligation of that task, not a completed field: it means the contract is not fixed yet.

test_cases.description: named conformance cases for the row. an empty array is an obligation of the owning task, not a completed field: registration alone is not evidence.

in_target.description: true exactly for the 48 Subsonic and 30 Navidrome target rows; false for support rows and for every retained_uncalled entry. it makes target membership explicit instead of inferring it from the array a row sits in.

endpoint_row.description: one compatibility path or support route. baseline and status come from the whio route inventory at the recorded revision: present-uncalled means registered outside the pinned client's called set, and those routes live in retained_uncalled, not here. Subsonic paths are relative to the compatibility base and include the suffixless and .view forms. required_response_fields and test_cases are empty until the owning task fixes the contract.

retained_row.description: a registered Subsonic-grammar or Navidrome-grammar route outside the pinned client's called set. it is not a target, so in_target is false, baseline is present-uncalled and status is registered; conformant is never assignable.

field_mapping.description: one foreign smart-rule field. facade_owner is the protocol task that translates the foreign name; owner_task holds the fact. proposed_value is the proposed whio fact and is not improved here.

sort_mapping.description: one foreign sort value and the whio order fact it must map to. an unsupported sort may not silently fall back to a title sort.

filter_translation.description: one foreign filter input group. names lists the foreign keys verbatim; foreign_input keeps the source cell. native documents selector meanings directly and does not accept arbitrary foreign keys.

operator.description: one client operator family. reference numeric contains/notContains and relative-date encodings need explicit cases; they are not rejected because whio prefers another operator set.

navidrome_profile.description: one cumulative Navidrome compatibility threshold. the obligation is cumulative, so a later threshold may not be advertised while an earlier one is unproved.

opensubsonic_extension.description: one OpenSubsonic extension. advertisement is a subset of implemented, tested and configured behaviour; an implemented route may stay unadvertised while staged.
